task: Media generation routing and composer/settings integration
confirmedFindings: The existing inline media form bypassed the normal composer experience and mixed image/video configuration.

The Sign in with ChatGPT interface does not expose hosted image generation. No documented native video-generation route was found for this authentication method. This is an interface limitation, not a claim that ChatGPT products cannot generate media.
A failure to load Third-Party Inference profiles previously interrupted discovery of otherwise available routes.
New-conversation configuration inheritance could carry media mode and source references into another conversation; the regression test now prevents this.
The shared select-menu CSS overrode the plus popup positioning during UI verification; the scoped portal rule now keeps it above the trigger.
implementation: One keyboard-accessible plus popup preserves attachment, project and voice actions and offers separate image/video modes.
Normal composer text supplies the generation prompt; removable mode chips, drafts and source selections are conversation-scoped.
Fresh image/video attachments take precedence over a previous edit reference and route to compatible editing/animation operations.
Independent image/video provider, model and output defaults are persisted through the existing settings service.
Media settings reuse Section, SettingRow, Toggle, CustomSelect, input and button styles; there is no native HTML select or inline media configuration form.
Catalog results separate connected accounts from supported interfaces, configured endpoints and billing authorization; unavailable details are expandable.
No-charge filtering requires verified included subscription entitlement, authorized free routes or local generation. Paid generation remains confirmation-controlled.
Dollar caps fail closed when a provider cannot supply a binding price quote; local token estimates are not treated as authoritative spending.
Generated media, actual provider/model labels, job monitoring, background notifications and native image/video controls retain existing services.

limitations: Subscription login and image/video understanding do not establish media-generation entitlement.
Cursor can emit documented native image output, but its included allowance/overage policy is not exposed; Athena does not classify that route as verified no-additional-charge.
Dedicated API and optional local routes still require the user's own compatible configuration and authorization.
Windows hardware and live remote video-generation services were not exercised in this macOS session.
Light-theme validation used shared CSS token overrides; the application does not currently expose a complete alternate light-theme setting.
